rules.applies_to: Licensed contractors and unlicensed persons cited by the CSLB Registrar for Contractors State License Law violations
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties.
rules.effective: 16 CCR 884 amended operative 3-2-2007; change without regulatory effect operative 1-1-2022; subsections (a) and (c) amended by change without regulatory effect filed 8-17-2023 (History Notes, PDF page 558)
rules.notes: Dollar ranges read directly from the printed table. Subject labels are NOT printed in the table; they were taken from section headings elsewhere in the 2026 Law Book (B&P Chapter 9 table of contents) to make the table usable. Six rows print a truncated section number ('7071.1', '7099.1', '7159.1' twice each) - keep their ranges but verify the exact section against the official 16 CCR 884 before relying on them. The table is the Registrar's per-section range; per-project caps in 884(c) also apply. Page 540 also appears in the prior chunk.

rules.title: Per-citation total cap when all violations are on the same project
rules.plain_english: If one citation lists several violations that all relate to the same construction project, the total penalty on that citation cannot exceed $8,000. The cap rises to $15,000 for B&P 7028.7 (unlicensed) violations and to $30,000 for violations of B&P 7110, 7114, 7118 or 7125.4.

parameters.trigger: citation lists more than one violation AND each violation relates to the same construction project

rules.applies_to: Any person receiving a multi-violation CSLB citation tied to a single construction project
rules.verbatim_quote: (c) Where a citation lists more than one violation and each of the violations relates to the same construction project, the total penalty assessment in each citation shall not exceed $ 8,000, except as provided for violations of Section 7028.7, in which case ... shall not exceed $ 15,000, and for violations of Sections 7110, 7114, 7118, or 7125.4, in which case ... shall not exceed $ 30,000.
rules.effective: Subsection (c) amended by change without regulatory effect filed 8-17-2023 (PDF page 558)
rules.notes: The text does not say how the cap works when a single citation mixes a $30,000-cap section with ordinary sections; a reasonable reading is that the higher cap applies to the citation, but treat as an interpretation. Cap does not apply when violations relate to different projects.

rules.title: Factors the Registrar weighs when setting the penalty amount
rules.plain_english: Within the allowed range, CSLB considers whether the citation has multiple violations, the person has a history of similar violations, bad faith, serious or harmful conduct, victims who are seniors or disabled, or work repairing natural disaster damage. Any of these can push the penalty toward the maximum.

factors: history of violations of the same or similar sections
violation is serious or harmful (Registrar's judgment)
violation perpetrated against a senior citizen or disabled person
violation involves a project repairing damage from a natural disaster as described in B&P 7158
parameters.effect: considered when determining amount within 884(a) range

rules.applies_to: Persons cited by CSLB; risk flag for projects with senior/disabled owners or disaster-repair work
rules.verbatim_quote: (b) When determining the amount of assessed civil penalty, the Registrar shall take into consideration whether one or more of the following or similar circumstances apply: (1) the citation includes multiple violations; (2) the cited person has a history of violations of the same or similar sections ...
rules.notes: List is non-exclusive ('or similar circumstances'). Item (6) cross-references B&P 7158 as printed. A tool can flag elevated penalty risk when customer age 65+/disabled (definitions not given here) or the job is disaster repair.

rules.title: Multi-violation citations must state the penalty per section
rules.plain_english: When a citation lists more than one violation, CSLB must state the penalty amount separately for each section violated, so the contractor can see and contest each amount.

parameters.trigger: citation lists more than one violation
parameters.requirement: civil penalty stated separately for each section violated

rules.applies_to: CSLB citations; useful for parsing/contesting citations
rules.verbatim_quote: (d) Where a citation lists more than one violation, the amount of assessed civil penalty shall be stated separately for each section violated.
rules.notes: Authority: B&P 7008, 7099.2; Reference: B&P 7099, 7099.1, 7115.

rules.title: Appeal a CSLB citation within 15 working days of receipt
rules.plain_english: A contractor served with a CSLB citation under B&P 7099 can contest it by appealing to the Registrar within 15 working days after receiving it. The Registrar may extend this for good cause.

parameters.trigger: receipt of citation issued under B&P 7099
parameters.extension: may be extended on showing of good cause, at Registrar's discretion

rules.applies_to: Licensees (and others) served with a citation pursuant to B&P 7099
rules.verbatim_quote: Any person served with a citation pursuant to Section 7099 of the Business and Professions Code may contest the citation by appealing to the Registrar within 15 working days from the receipt of such citation. The 15 day period may be extended upon showing of good cause which determination is within the discretion of the Registrar.
rules.effective: New section effective 30th day after filing 4-7-81; renumbered 806 to 885 on 2-27-84 (PDF page 559)
rules.notes: 'Working days' is not defined here; a calculator should exclude weekends and California state holidays. Citations of unlicensed persons under B&P 7028.7 have their own appeal provision (B&P 7028.10, not in this chunk).

rules.title: What a contractor can contest in a citation appeal
rules.plain_english: In a citation appeal you can contest any or all of: whether a violation happened, whether the order of correction is reasonable, the time allowed to correct, and the amount of the civil penalty.

contestable_aspects: occurrence of a violation of the Contractors License Law
reasonableness of the order of correction (if included)
period of time allowed for correction (if order of correction included)
amount of the civil penalty (if assessed)

rules.applies_to: Persons appealing a CSLB citation under B&P 7099
rules.verbatim_quote: The cited person may contest any or all of the following aspects of the citation: 1. The occurrence of a violation of the Contractors License Law; 2. The reasonableness of the order of correction, if an order of correction is included in the citation; 3. The period of time allowed for correction, ... 4. The amount of the civil penalty, if a civil penalty is assessed in the citation.
rules.notes: Reference: B&P 7099.3, 7099.4, 7099.5. A tool can generate an appeal checklist with these four grounds.

rules.title: How CSLB serves a citation
rules.plain_english: CSLB serves citations using the method in Government Code 11505(c) and also sends a copy by regular mail. The receipt date starts the 15-working-day appeal clock.

parameters.downstream_effect: receipt date triggers 16 CCR 885 appeal deadline

rules.verbatim_quote: Service of a citation shall be made in accordance with the provisions of Section 11505(c) of the Government Code, and, further, that a copy of the citation be sent by regular mail.
rules.effective: New section effective 30th day after filing 4-7-81; renumbered 806.1 to 886 (PDF page 559)
rules.notes: Gov. Code 11505(c) text is not printed here (generally personal delivery or registered/certified mail - confirm). Contractors should keep their CSLB address of record current so citations are received.

rules.title: Gravity factors for penalties on unlicensed contractors (B&P 7028.7)
rules.plain_english: Before setting a penalty against an unlicensed person cited under B&P 7028.7, CSLB considers how serious the conduct was, such as falsely claiming to be licensed, taking money without doing the work, using false documents or statements, misusing funds, doing hazardous or substandard work, breaking building/safety/labor/insurance laws, criminal convictions, and repeat violations.

criteria: failed to perform work for which money was received
executed or used false or misleading documents to induce contract or payment
made false or misleading statements to induce contract or payment
failed to apply funds received for services, labor, materials or equipment
performed work potentially hazardous to public health, safety or welfare
performed work violating building, safety, labor, compensation insurance or unemployment insurance laws
performed work not meeting acceptable trade standards
convicted of a crime in connection with the violation
committed any act that would be cause for discipline against a licensee

rules.applies_to: Unlicensed persons performing contracting work; owners evaluating risk of hiring unlicensed persons
rules.verbatim_quote: Before assessing a civil penalty under Section 7028.7 of the Business and Professions Code, the Registrar shall give due consideration to the gravity of the violation, including, but not limited to, a consideration of whether the cited person did one or more of the following: 1. Falsely represented that he/she was licensed. 2. Failed to perform work for which money was received.
rules.effective: New section effective 30th day after filing 5-13-82; renumbered 807 to 887 (PDF page 559)
rules.notes: Penalty range for 7028.7 ($200-$15,000) is from 16 CCR 884(a). The Law Book TOC shows two versions of B&P 7028.7 (one effective until July 1, 2026); check which applies to the citation date.

rules.title: Minimum qualifications for CSLB arbitrators
rules.plain_english: Arbitrators in CSLB arbitration (B&P 7085) must have 5 years of construction-industry experience as a licensed contractor or construction professional, or 5 years as an attorney/judge/arbitrator handling at least 8 construction matters; plus a construction arbitration course within the last 5 years, 8 hours of construction-arbitration continuing education every 5 years, and CSLB-specific arbitration training.

experience_option_1.role: licensed contractor or construction-related professional (e.g., architect, engineer)

experience_option_2.role: attorney, judge, administrative law judge, arbitrator or combination

parameters.course_required: arbitrator's course on construction arbitration (process, ethics, laws)

rules.applies_to: Contractors and owners in CSLB-referred arbitration under B&P 7085 et seq.; arbitrators
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) (1) Five (5) years of experience in the construction industry as a licensed contractor or a professional in a construction related field, such as an architect or engineer, or (2) Five (5) years of experience as an attorney, judge, administrative law judge, arbitrator, or a combination thereof, handling a minimum of 8 construction related matters.
rules.effective: New Article 9 and section filed 10-31-2001; operative 11-30-2001 (PDF page 559)
rules.notes: Parties can use this to check whether an assigned arbitrator is qualified. Authority: B&P 7008, 7085.5(b)(3).

rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7111 100 1,000
rules.notes: Retention period is in B&P 7111 (not this chunk).

rules.title: Penalty: failing to cooperate in a CSLB investigation (B&P 7111.1)
rules.plain_english: Failing to respond to or cooperate with a CSLB complaint investigation (B&P 7111.1) carries a civil penalty of $100 to $1,500.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7111.1 100 1,500
rules.notes: Subject label from B&P heading.

rules.title: Penalty: failing to complete project for the contract price (B&P 7113)
rules.plain_english: Failing to complete a project for the contract price (B&P 7113) carries a civil penalty of $200 to $8,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7113 200 8,000
rules.notes: Subject label from B&P heading 'Failure to Complete Project for Contract Price'.

rules.title: Penalty: aiding and abetting an unlicensed person (B&P 7114)
rules.plain_english: Helping an unlicensed person evade the license law, such as lending your license (B&P 7114), carries a civil penalty of $500 to $30,000, with a $30,000 per-citation cap for one project.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7114 500 30,000
rules.notes: Example ('lending your license') is illustrative; elements are in B&P 7114 (not this chunk).

rules.title: Penalty: certifying false experience (B&P 7114.1)
rules.plain_english: Certifying false work experience for a license applicant (B&P 7114.1) carries a civil penalty of $200 to $2,000.
rules.applies_to: Licensees and others certifying applicant experience
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7114.1 200 2,000
rules.notes: Subject label from B&P heading.

rules.title: Penalty: general violation of the Contractors License Law (B&P 7115)
rules.plain_english: A general violation of the Contractors License Law or its rules (B&P 7115) carries a civil penalty of $100 to $8,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7115 100 8,000
rules.notes: Catch-all section; often cited with violations of CSLB regulations.

rules.title: Penalty: willful or fraudulent act (B&P 7116)
rules.plain_english: A willful or fraudulent act that substantially injures another (B&P 7116) carries a civil penalty of $100 to $8,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7116 100 8,000
rules.notes: 'Substantially injures another' element is from B&P 7116, not printed in this chunk.

rules.title: Penalty: contracting under a name or personnel different from the license (B&P 7117)
rules.plain_english: Contracting under a name or with personnel that differ from what is on the license record (B&P 7117) carries a civil penalty of $100 to $1,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7117 100 1,000
rules.notes: A tool can check that the business name on contracts matches the CSLB license record.

rules.title: Penalty: contracting with an inactive, suspended or expired license (B&P 7117.5)
rules.plain_english: Contracting while your license is inactive, suspended or expired (B&P 7117.5) carries a civil penalty of $200 to $8,000.
rules.applies_to: Licensees whose license is not active
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7117.5 200 8,000
rules.notes: A tool should block bids/contracts when license status is not active.

rules.title: Penalty: contracting out of classification (B&P 7117.6)
rules.plain_english: Contracting for work outside the classifications your license holds (B&P 7117.6) carries a civil penalty of $200 to $8,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7117.6 200 8,000
rules.notes: Pair with classification scope rules (16 CCR 830-834) to check work against held classes.

rules.title: Penalty: contracting with an unlicensed person (B&P 7118)
rules.plain_english: A licensee who enters a contract with an unlicensed contractor (B&P 7118) faces a civil penalty of $500 to $30,000, with a $30,000 per-citation cap for one project.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7118 500 30,000
rules.notes: Strong case for automated subcontractor license verification before signing.

rules.title: Penalty: asbestos-related inspection with knowledge of report (B&P 7118.4)
rules.plain_english: Violating B&P 7118.4 (asbestos-related inspection with knowledge of a report) carries the highest minimum in the table: $3,000 to $8,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7118.4 3,000 8,000
rules.notes: Subject label from B&P heading 'Asbestos Related Inspection with Knowledge of Report'; elements in B&P 7118.4 (not this chunk).

rules.title: Penalty: contracting with uncertified person for asbestos work (B&P 7118.5)
rules.plain_english: Contracting with an uncertified person to do asbestos-related work (B&P 7118.5) carries a civil penalty of $1,000 to $8,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7118.5 1,000 8,000
rules.notes: Verify asbestos certification of subs before contracting.

rules.title: Penalty: contracting with uncertified person for hazardous substance removal (B&P 7118.6)
rules.plain_english: Contracting with an uncertified person to perform hazardous substance removal or remedial action (B&P 7118.6) carries a civil penalty of $1,000 to $8,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7118.6 1,000 8,000
rules.notes: Subject label from B&P heading 'Sanctions for contracting with uncertified person to perform removal or ...'.

rules.title: Penalty: lack of reasonable diligence (B&P 7119)
rules.plain_english: Failing without legal excuse to prosecute a project with reasonable diligence (B&P 7119) carries a civil penalty of $200 to $2,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7119 200 2,000
rules.notes: Subject label from B&P heading 'Lack of Reasonable Diligence'.

rules.title: Penalty: failure to pay money owed (B&P 7120)
rules.plain_english: Failing to pay money due for materials or services as described in B&P 7120 carries a civil penalty of $200 to $2,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7120 200 2,000
rules.notes: Subject label from B&P heading 'Failure to Pay Money'; elements in B&P 7120.

rules.title: Penalty: conviction of a crime (B&P 7123)
rules.plain_english: A licensee convicted of a crime substantially related to contracting (B&P 7123) can be cited with a civil penalty of $500 to $8,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7123 500 8,000
rules.notes: 'Substantially related' standard is from B&P 7123 / 16 CCR 868, not printed here.

rules.title: Penalty: workers' compensation reporting to Registrar (B&P 7125)
rules.plain_english: Failing to keep a current workers' compensation certificate or exemption on file with CSLB as B&P 7125 requires carries a civil penalty of $100 to $500.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7125 100 500
rules.notes: TOC heading 'Reports to registrar; Exemptions'; two versions of B&P 7125 exist (one operative January 1, 2028).

rules.title: Penalty: workers' compensation violations (B&P 7125.4)
rules.plain_english: Workers' compensation violations under B&P 7125.4 (e.g., false exemption or failing to carry required coverage) carry a civil penalty of $200 to $30,000, with a $30,000 per-citation cap for one project.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7125.4 200 30,000
rules.notes: TOC heading 'Causes for disciplinary action; Misdemeanor'. Examples are illustrative; elements are in B&P 7125.4.

rules.title: Penalty: using a nonregistered home improvement salesperson (B&P 7154)
rules.plain_english: Employing a home improvement salesperson who is not registered with CSLB (B&P 7154) carries a civil penalty of $100 to $1,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7154 100 1,000
rules.notes: Subject label from B&P heading 'Employment of a Nonregistered Home Improvement ...'.

rules.title: Penalty: prohibited home improvement inducements (B&P 7157)
rules.plain_english: Offering prohibited inducements (such as gifts or bonuses tied to future referrals) to win a home improvement contract (B&P 7157) carries a civil penalty of $100 to $1,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7157 100 1,000
rules.notes: Example is illustrative; prohibited acts are listed in B&P 7157.

rules.title: Penalty: false completion certificate (B&P 7158)
rules.plain_english: Accepting or obtaining a false certificate of completion for home improvement work financed by a third party (B&P 7158) carries a civil penalty of $500 to $8,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7158 500 8,000
rules.notes: Financing detail is from general knowledge of B&P 7158; confirm in B&P text.

rules.title: Penalty: home improvement contract requirements (B&P 7159)
rules.plain_english: A home improvement contract that does not meet the content and form requirements of B&P 7159 can draw a civil penalty of $100 to $1,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7159 100 1,000
rules.notes: A contract generator that satisfies B&P 7159 avoids this exposure.

rules.title: Penalty: HIC contract amount, downpayment limit, payment ahead of work (B&P 7159.5(a)(1),(3),(5))
rules.plain_english: Violating B&P 7159.5(a)(1) (written contract with full dollar amount), (a)(3) (downpayment limit) or (a)(5) (no payment beyond work performed/materials delivered) carries a civil penalty of $100 to $8,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7159.5(a)(1), (a)(3), 100 8,000 and (a)(5),
rules.notes: Subsection subjects and the $1,000/10% downpayment limit are from B&P 7159.5 text (2026 Law Book PDF pages 410-411), not this chunk. These are also misdemeanors under 7159.5(b).

rules.title: Penalty: HIC finance charge, payment schedule, lien releases, commissions, bond exemption (B&P 7159.5(a)(2),(4),(6),(7),(8))
rules.plain_english: Violating B&P 7159.5(a)(2) (separate finance charge), (a)(4) (payment schedule), (a)(6) (lien releases on request), (a)(7) (pro rata salesperson commission) or (a)(8) (bond/joint control exemption terms) carries a civil penalty of $100 to $1,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7159.5(a)(2), (a)(4), (a)(6), (a)(7), and 100 1,000 (a)(8)
rules.notes: Subsection subjects summarized from B&P 7159.5 text (2026 Law Book PDF pages 410-411), not this chunk.

rules.title: Penalty: misrepresentation or false advertising (B&P 7161)
rules.plain_english: Prohibited acts under B&P 7161, such as misrepresenting a material fact to get a contract or false advertising, carry a civil penalty of $100 to $8,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7161 100 8,000
rules.notes: TOC heading 'Specification of prohibited acts; Misdemeanor'; Index lists false or misleading advertising at 7160-7161.

rules.title: Penalty: representations about goods, materials or brand (B&P 7162)
rules.plain_english: Violating B&P 7162 on contract contents and representations about goods, materials, trademark or brand carries a civil penalty of $100 to $1,500.
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7162 100 1,500
rules.notes: TOC heading 'Contents of contract; Representations as to goods and materials'.

rules.title: Penalty: single-family dwelling contract not in writing (B&P 7164)
rules.plain_english: Failing to put a contract to build a single-family dwelling (and changes to it) in writing as required by B&P 7164 carries a civil penalty of $100 to $1,000.
rules.applies_to: Contractors building single-family dwellings for owners
rules.verbatim_quote: (a) Civil penalties against persons who have been cited for violation of the Contractors State License Law shall be assessed in accordance with the following ranges of penalties. ... 7164 100 1,000
rules.notes: TOC heading 'Contract and changes to be in writing; Requirements'.

rules.title: C-49 Tree and Palm classification operative January 1, 2024
rules.plain_english: The C-49 Tree and Palm Contractor classification took effect January 1, 2024, along with an amendment to the specialty classification rule (16 CCR 832) on the same date.

rules.title: C-22 Asbestos Abatement class and asbestos classification limits operative January 1, 2015
rules.plain_english: The C-22 Asbestos Abatement classification (16 CCR 832.22) and the rule on asbestos classification and certification limits and the exam requirement (16 CCR 833) both became operative January 1, 2015.
rules.verbatim_quote: 833. ASBESTOS CLASSIFICATION AND CERTIFICATION LIMITATIONS AND EXAMINATION REQUIREMENT 1. New section filed 12-30-2014; operative 1-1-2015 pursuant to Government Code section 11343.4(b)(3)

rules.title: C-14 Metal Roofing classification repealed
rules.plain_english: The C-14 Metal Roofing classification was repealed in 2013 and is no longer a valid class; treat a C-14 entry as obsolete.
rules.verbatim_quote: 832.14. CLASS C-14—METAL ROOFING CONTRACTOR 1. New section filed 10-22-86 ... 2. Repealer and new section filed 6-22-98 ... 3. Change without regulatory effect repealing section filed 8-7-2013 pursuant to section 100, title 1, California Code of Regulations (Register 2013, No. 32).
rules.notes: 832.14 also appears (without the repeal entry) in the current-rules history notes on PDF page 549; the repealed-rules entry controls. Metal roofing falls under C-39 Roofing (C-39 amended operative 7-1-98, same date as the 1998 C-14 rewrite) - confirm scope in 16 CCR 832.39.

rules.title: C-26 Lathing class repealed; C-35 is Lathing and Plastering
rules.plain_english: The separate C-26 Lathing classification was repealed effective January 1, 1998, and the C-35 class heading became 'Lathing and Plastering' the same date. Treat C-26 as obsolete.
rules.verbatim_quote: 832.35. CLASS C-35—LATHING AND PLASTERING CONTRACTOR 1. Amendment of section heading, new subsection (a) designator and new subsections (b) and (c) filed 12-18-97; operative 1-1-98

rules.title: C-5 Framing/Rough Carpentry and C-6 Cabinet, Millwork and Finish Carpentry (operative 2003)
rules.plain_english: Since January 1, 2003, C-5 is 'Framing and Rough Carpentry' and C-6 is 'Cabinet, Millwork and Finish Carpentry'. The old C-6 'Cabinet and Millwork' class was repealed effective January 1, 1998.

rules.title: Blanket performance and payment bond regulations (16 CCR 858-858.9), operative 12-22-2011
rules.plain_english: The blanket performance and payment bond program, which lets home improvement contractors with an approved blanket bond skip the downpayment and progress-payment limits, is governed by 16 CCR 858-858.9, operative December 22, 2011. Those rules cover the definition, requirements, application, denial standards, biennial certification and financial reporting, audits, bond increases, maintenance, rescission and posting to license records.

rules.title: CSLB regulation amendments 2021-2025 (version check)
rules.plain_english: Several CSLB regulations were amended or repealed between 2021 and 2025. A compliance tool should make sure its rule text reflects these versions: definitions (810), fees (811), classification and scope rules, renewal form (853), blanket bond application (858.1-858.2), criminal-history criteria (868-869.9), order-of-correction extension (883) and civil penalties (884).
